description: This Java class defines the 'Meeting' entity within the Fineract project, representing meetings in a financial portfolio context. It includes methods for creating, updating, and managing attendance, as well as validation logic for meeting dates.

classes.name: Meeting
classes.description: Represents a meeting entity with date, calendar association, and client attendance management within the Fineract system.

methods.name: createNew
methods.description: Creates a new Meeting instance after validating the meeting date.

methods.name: associateClientsAttendance
methods.description: Associates a collection of client attendance records with the meeting, ensuring the date is not in the future.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates the meeting's date based on a JsonCommand, with validation.

methods.name: updateAttendance
methods.description: Updates attendance records for clients in the meeting.

methods.name: entityId
methods.description: Returns the entity ID associated with the meeting's calendar instance.

methods.name: isCenterEntity
methods.description: Checks if the meeting's calendar entity is a center.

methods.name: isGroupEntity
methods.description: Checks if the meeting's calendar entity is a group.

methods.name: getMeetingDateLocalDate
methods.description: Returns the meeting date as a LocalDate object.

methods.name: isMeetingDateBefore
methods.description: Checks if the meeting date is before a given date.

methods.name: getClientsAttendance
methods.description: Retrieves the collection of client attendance records.
